source: FAA AIS Open Data - ATS Route
note: Clipped to ZNY/ZBW/ZOB/ZDC, split by FAA DIRECTION, stitched into continuous runs. dir is E or W for one-way segments and BOTH where the FAA lists no direction — BOTH means the data does not say, NOT that traffic is balanced. BE/BW segments are folded into BOTH rather than guessed at. J121 and J174 were cancelled in April 2023 and are absent from FAA data.
